general.body: Task 1: always write an overview of the main trends. No overview means a maximum of band 5 for Task Achievement.
Task 2: answer every part of the question and make your opinion clear in the introduction and conclusion.
Plan for 5 minutes before you write. It saves time later.
Leave 3 minutes to check articles, verb tenses and plurals.

beginner.body: Simple plan: 1) Rewrite the question in your own words. 2) One overview sentence with the biggest trends. 3) Two body paragraphs with numbers. No opinions in Task 1.
Simple plan: Introduction (repeat the question + your opinion) → Body 1 (one idea + example) → Body 2 (another idea + example) → Conclusion. Aim for 260–280 words.

intermediate.body: Examiners look for a clear overview. Write one sentence with the biggest trends before any numbers.
Answer every part of the question. A 'discuss both views' question needs both sides AND your opinion.

advanced.body: Group the data rather than listing it, and use varied comparison language (roughly double, a sixteen-fold rise).
Keep a consistent position throughout and extend each idea with a reason, a consequence and a specific example.

professional.body: Band 8+: precise data selection, no listing every figure, sophisticated but natural comparisons.
Band 8+: nuanced position, fully extended ideas, precise collocations, flexible complex grammar with very few errors.
